Header: Orseolia oryzae Vernacular Name: Annai komban.

Prevention: Remove alternate weed hosts such as sedges and grasses
Flood irrigation reduces the incidence of gall midge.
Conserve natural enemies like spider, Praying
Mantis, Dragon fly, Water strider etc.
Monitoring: Observe for formation of tube like galls from nursery to active tillering stage
Observe regularly for tube galls (silver shoot) during 35 to 45
Observe for relative humidity 83 to 87% with intermittent rain from
November which is favourable for pest.
Observe for mosquito like yellow or brown coloured insects with long legs during early hours.
Monitor the economic threshold level up to 10% of silver shoot.
Direct Control: Follow spacing of 22.5 x 22.5 cm while transplanting.
